meaning:
Gob = "cistern"
a place which was the scene of two encounters between David's warriors and the Philistines (also '"Gezer')
Another name of ge.zer (גֶּ֫זֶר "Gezer" H1507)

elsewhere.note: After this, there was again war with the Philistines at Gob. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, who was of the sons of the giant.
